scope: Theorem IntegerFactoring.HalfAppendix.sqrtLogLog_factoring : Factoring.SqrtLogLogConjecture (formal-appendix/HalfTheorem.lean, L73, main e91442d3). Factoring.SqrtLogLogConjecture is defined in Rudich and Rousseau's Challenge.lean (c91cc3f4, L76-77): for some C, the smallest prime factor of an n-bit number is computed in time C * 2^(C*n/(sqrt(log n)+1)). In the scale of this board that is time 2^{b/(log b)^{1/2-o(1)}}: score 1/2.
